text:
## Summary of Work So Far

### Completed Requirements:
- **[R1]** Added 'l' (letters) format specifier matching alphabetic characters only (`[a-zA-Z]+`)
- **[R2]** Added `__contains__` method to Result class checking fixed/named values
- **[R3]** Added `_validate_braces()` method to Parser.__init__ that raises ValueError on unmatched or nested braces
- **[R8]** Fixed `findall()` bug where it created a second Parser without passing `case_sensitive` parameter
- **[R10]** Added slice access to Result via modified `__getitem__` handling slice objects

### Still Pending:
- **[R4]** Fix FixedTzOffset timezone parsing (Bug 92) - need to investigate the actual bug
- **[R5]** Support Fortran-formatted floating-point numbers (e.g., `1H1.2E+02` format)
- **[R6]** Improve hex/binary/octal integer conversion with optional base arguments and automatic detection
- **[R7]** Replace lambdas/inner functions with picklable functors (currently using lambdas for f, F, e, g types and inner function in int_convert)
- **[R9]** Make left/center alignment consume input up to next space character

### Current State:
All 74 existing tests still pass. The parse.py file has been modified with changes for R1, R2, R3, R8, and R10. Remaining work involves implementing R4-R7 and R9 while ensuring all existing tests continue to pass.
